# InputCopy props

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string \| (readonly string[] & string)` | required | The value of the input. Use when controlled. The text to display in the input and copy to the clipboard. |
| `labels` | `Partial<InputCopyLabels>` | — | Replaces the built-in English strings, e.g. to translate them. Keys you leave out keep the default from `DEFAULT_INPUT_COPY_LABELS`. |

## Labels

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `copy` | `string` | `"Copy to clipboard"` | Name of the button before a copy. |
| `copied` | `string` | `"Copied"` | Name of the button while it shows the copied state. |
